svg.title: Quantization: storing model weights with fewer bits
svg.text: Quantization: the same model in fewer bits
Bar length = bits per weight (drawn to scale by average bits per weight; real files add a little metadata)
about 8.5 bits: half the size, almost no quality loss
about 4.8 bits: the usual choice for 8B models on an 8 GB card
• Report section 6: Qwen3-8B in Q4_K_M locally scored the same as the cloud version (60.4% vs 60.4%).
• Quantization applies to model weights (Q4_K_M, Q8_0 in GGUF file names) and to the KV cache (q8_0 KV).
• "K" is llama.cpp's block quantization, "_M" a medium setting; fewer bits save memory but risk quality.
